stories.title: After fatal Nedumbassery accident, Keralam govt to tighten action against bars serving alcohol to under-23s

en.title: After fatal Nedumbassery accident, Keralam govt to tighten action against bars serving alcohol to under-23s
en.summary: Following a fatal accident involving a 19-year-old driver, Kerala's Excise Minister announced stricter enforcement against bars serving alcohol to minors. The department has already registered cases against three establishments accused of serving the driver involved in the incident.

stories.title: ‘Mayangilla Keralam’ drive boosting anti-drug efforts; over 10,000 cases filed under Operation Thunder, says Excise Minister

en.title: 'Mayangilla Keralam' drive boosting anti-drug efforts; over 10,000 cases filed under Operation Thunder, says Excise Minister
en.summary: Kerala's Excise Minister reported progress in anti-drug initiatives through the 'Mayangilla Keralam' campaign, with Operation Thunder generating over 10,000 cases. The minister outlined four strategic components: enforcement, awareness, de-addiction services, and rehabilitation programs.

stories.title: Madras High Court calls for report on complaint against Udhayanidhi Stalin’s election affidavit

en.title: Madras High Court calls for report on complaint against Udhayanidhi Stalin's election affidavit
en.summary: The Madras High Court has requested a report regarding a complaint filed against Udhayanidhi Stalin's election affidavit. A judge set October 15, 2026 as the deadline for the metropolitan magistrate's court in Chennai to submit the report.

stories.title: No respite for AIADMK, Madras High Court upholds resignations of six MLAs who joined Vijay’s party

en.title: No respite for AIADMK, Madras High Court upholds resignations of six MLAs who joined Vijay's party
en.summary: The Madras High Court upheld the resignations of six AIADMK legislators who switched to Vijay's party. The ruling provides no relief for the AIADMK in their effort to retain these members.

stories.title: Madras High Court prevents unauthorised exhibition of Rajinikanth-starrer Jailer 2 and Shivarajkumar’s Bail

en.title: Madras High Court prevents unauthorised exhibition of Rajinikanth-starrer Jailer 2 and Shivarajkumar's Bail
en.summary: A Madras High Court judge issued interim injunction orders in copyright infringement cases filed by Sun TV Network Limited and KVN Productions LLP regarding unauthorized exhibitions of two films.

stories.title: Madras High Court upholds Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker’s decision to accept resignations of six AIADMK MLAs

en.title: Madras High Court upholds Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker's decision to accept resignations of six AIADMK MLAs
en.summary: The Madras High Court confirmed the Speaker's acceptance of resignations from six AIADMK legislators while directing completion of disqualification proceedings for four of them within two months.

stories.title: ‘Duty bound to protect’: Madras High Court upholds school official’s POCSO conviction

en.title: 'Duty bound to protect': Madras High Court upholds school official's POCSO conviction
en.summary: A Madras High Court upheld the conviction of a school official under POCSO provisions, affirming the court's duty to protect children.

stories.title: After MINI Cooper crash, Kerala minister vows strict action against bars serving alcohol to people under 23

en.title: After MINI Cooper crash, Kerala minister vows strict action against bars serving alcohol to people under 23
en.summary: Following a MINI Cooper accident, a Kerala minister pledged to enforce strict measures against establishments serving alcohol to individuals below age 23.

stories.title: UPI Merchant Charges Above Rs 2,000 To Be Implemented After Diwali

en.title: UPI Merchant Charges Above Rs 2,000 To Be Implemented After Diwali
en.summary: Merchant discount rate charges on UPI payments exceeding Rs 2,000 will be introduced following Diwali. The proposal has encountered significant opposition since its announcement.

stories.title: Madras High Court Upholds Speaker's Greenlight To 6 AIADMK MLAs' Resignation

en.title: Madras High Court Upholds Speaker's Greenlight To 6 AIADMK MLAs' Resignation
en.summary: The Madras High Court confirmed that the Speaker can accept MLAs' resignations without issuing prior notice to them. Six AIADMK MLAs' resignations were approved by the Speaker.

stories.title: Delhi High Court to hear Congress youth wing’s plea to protest against CEC at Jantar Mantar

en.title: Delhi High Court to hear Congress youth wing's plea to protest against CEC at Jantar Mantar
en.summary: The Delhi High Court will consider a petition from Congress's youth wing seeking permission to stage a protest against the Chief Election Commissioner at Jantar Mantar.

stories.title: Caught on cam: Punjab anti-drug activist shot dead after confronting chemist over 'drug sales'

en.title: Caught on cam: Punjab anti-drug activist shot dead after confronting chemist over 'drug sales'
en.summary: A Punjab anti-drug activist was fatally shot after confronting a medical store owner about selling prohibited substances during a sting operation in Mansa. Police identified the shooter and initiated a manhunt.

stories.title: Ircon International shares jump 7% on Rs 862 crore railway EPC contract win

en.title: Ircon International shares jump 7% on Rs 862 crore railway EPC contract win
en.summary: Ircon International's stock rose 7% following the company's securing of an Rs 862.46 crore engineering, procurement, and construction contract from East Central Railway for railway track work on the Son Nagar–Andal project.

stories.title: Bandhan Bank shares jump 7% as Abu Dhabi’s IHC explores stake in promoter Bandhan Financial Services

en.title: Bandhan Bank shares jump 7% as Abu Dhabi's IHC explores stake in promoter Bandhan Financial Services
en.summary: Bandhan Bank's shares increased 7% following reports that Abu Dhabi-based IHC is considering early-stage talks to acquire a stake in Bandhan Financial Services, the promoter entity, potentially providing an exit for current investors.

stories.title: Polycab shares tumble 5% as stock set to exit F&O segment from December 30 onwards. Here's why

en.title: Polycab shares tumble 5% as stock set to exit F&O segment from December 30 onwards. Here's why
en.summary: Polycab India shares declined over 5% after the NSE announced the company's removal from the futures and options segment effective December 30, stemming from insolvency proceedings despite a court stay on the order.

stories.title: ICICI Prudential AMC shares rise 2% as Jefferies, other brokerages revise target prices after Q2 results. Should you buy?

en.title: ICICI Prudential AMC shares rise 2% as Jefferies, other brokerages revise target prices after Q2 results. Should you buy?
en.summary: ICICI Prudential AMC shares rose 2% after the company reported a 6% year-over-year increase in net profit to Rs 889 crore in Q2 FY27, with multiple brokerages maintaining positive ratings and declaring a Rs 30 dividend.

stories.title: RBL Bank shares plunge 8% despite 170% jump in Q2 profit. Should you buy, sell or hold?

en.title: RBL Bank shares plunge 8% despite 170% jump in Q2 profit. Should you buy, sell or hold?
en.summary: RBL Bank's stock declined 8% despite quarterly profit surging 170% year-on-year to Rs 481.7 crore, supported by strong net interest income and improved asset quality. Analysts offered mixed views, with Nuvama raising its target to Rs 500 and Dolat Capital maintaining a sell rating at Rs 320.
